title: SB164 (2025 Regular): Revises provisions relating to permits to carry a concealed firearm. (BDR 15-607)

provenance.note: As-filed text (prefiled Feb. 3, 2025); no passage vote is recorded. Section 1 (NRS 202.366, subsection 4) strikes the 5-year term and substitutes 10 years; that sentence is not quoted because the struck number sits inside it. Only the application clause is quoted.

operative_text: Section 2 (NRS 202.366): The amendatory provisions of this act apply to a permit to carry a concealed firearm that is issued on or after October 1, 2025.
